Northvale Press

A countertop press built on the Northvale Kettle body. Brushed steel and glass, welded seams, silicone-sealed base. Made for daily brewing rather than occasional use, with a wider base and a heavier gauge than our travel range. The steel takes a couple of weeks to soften, after which the fit settles about half a size roomier. Available in three colourways in whole sizes only.
